steps.title: Retrieve GBD Data
steps.instruction: Extract the necessary health metrics from the GBD data repository.

substeps.instruction: Navigate to https://vizhub.healthdata.org/gbd-compare/ and use sidebars/menus to select causes.

Retrieve the following primary parameters: age-standardized mortality rate, age-standardized prevalence rate, age-standardized incidence rate, age-standardized Disability-adjusted life years (DALYs) rate, age-standardized years of life lost (YLLs) rate, and age-standardized years lived with disability (YLDs) rate.
Manually inspect each parameter for zero estimates; eliminate strata with zero or very low estimates (e.g., limit gastric cancer analysis to adults) to avoid code interference.
Download the data in CSV format from the upper right corner.

steps.title: Install R Packages
steps.instruction: Prepare the R environment by installing required packages.

substeps.instruction: Run the 'Installing Packages.R' script or install packages manually.

steps.title: Prepare and Prune Data
steps.instruction: Clean the exported GBD data to reduce size and standardize location naming.

substeps.instruction: Import the ISO-3 naming file (ISO3.dta) into R using the 'read_dta13' command.
Merge the ISO-3 names into the main data file using 'location_name' or 'location_id' to ensure consistency for mapping and merging.
Recode 'Georgia' if it appears as both a nation and a US state to avoid merge errors.

steps.title: Calculate Quality of Care Index (QCI)
steps.instruction: Execute the QCI analysis script to calculate secondary parameters and perform Principal Component Analysis (PCA).

substeps.instruction: Load the libraries (Lines 1-27 of QCI.R).
Define age-groups on line 44 (default is >1-year-old; options available on line 51).
On line 64, select 'Rate' for age-standardized estimates or 'Number' for all-age estimates.
Define and run the 'create_data' function (line 28).
When prompted, provide the file paths for: 1) the main GBD data file (.dta format), 2) the ISO3.dta file, and 3) the output save folder.
Wait for the script to export 'main_data.dta' and 'variance_first_component.dta'.

Note: The script calculates four secondary parameters (mortality-to-incidence ratio [MIR], prevalence-to-incidence ratio, YLLs-to-YLDs ratio, and DALYs-to-prevalence ratio) and uses the first component of PCA to generate the QCI (scaled 0-100). If deaths are near zero, modify the code to remove MIR.

steps.title: Create Visualizations and Maps
steps.instruction: Generate maps using the 'ggplot2' and 'sf' packages.

substeps.instruction: Run the 'Map.R' script; install packages via the first line if it is the first usage, otherwise start from line 4.
Load libraries (lines 4-13).
Run line 14 and select the 'main_data.dta' file from the QCI step.
Run line 15 and select the 'ISO3.dta' file.
Specify the desired year and sex ('Male', 'Female', or 'Both') on line 20.
Run the remaining code line by line and save the resulting map manually or using the 'ggsave' command.

steps.title: Calculate Gender Disparity Ratio (GDR)
steps.instruction: Calculate the GDR based on the QCI of males and females.

substeps.instruction: Run the 'GDR.R' script; install packages via the first line if it is the first usage, otherwise start from line 4.
Load libraries (lines 4-13).
Run line 14 and select the 'main_data.dta' file.
Run line 15 and select the 'ISO3.dta' file.
Specify the desired year on line 20.
Run the remaining code line by line and save the resulting map manually or using the 'ggsave' command.
